description: Land Title Settlement Dept. -Bogamuwa, Gampaha D/S Division, Gampaha District   - Cad. Map No. 511800
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains detailed declarations of land title determinations for specific parcels of land, including parcel numbers, owner names, extent of land, title classifications, and encumbrances. The content is focused on land ownership and property rights, falling squarely within the Land Gazette category (Type 4) which covers land registrations, property ownership, and land title matters.
